parameters.query:
SELECT
  current_state,
  split_part(current_state, '|', 2) AS mode,
  NULLIF(split_part(current_state, '|', 3), '')::INTEGER AS playlist_id,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - state_started_at)) AS seconds_elapsed
FROM pocketsound_user_states
WHERE user_id = {{ $('Check user in DB').first().json.id }}
  AND current_state LIKE 'awaiting_playlist_name|%'
  AND state_started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (LOWER(f.title), LOWER(f.artist))
  f.id,
  f.title,
  f.artist,
  f.tg_chat_id,
  f.message_id
FROM pocketsound_file_search_index s
JOIN pocketsound_files f ON f.id = s.file_id
WHERE f.is_searchable = true
  AND ({{ $json.sql_condition }})
ORDER BY LOWER(f.title), LOWER(f.artist), f.created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;
